The '''Reconquest of Ord Radama''' was a major battle of the [[Rim Campaign]]—one of the large military campaigns near the final years of the [[Great Galactic War]]. Fought between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|army]] under the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]] and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knights]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], the Reconquest lasted over fifty-one days and saw massive losses on both sides. Malgus and his forces ultimately proved successful and succeeded in destroying their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] foes.
